_comment_deploy: Redeployed after a gas-bounding security fix; the earlier hub at 0x4958a4ADbf75AF01dBeE5c2AED5aAcD391c4bdd9 predates the fix and was superseded before any agent was provisioned against it (see docs/PROOF.md). hub/escrowDeployer/loanDeployer/block above were re-read live from this hub's own owner()/underwriter()/escrowDeployer()/loanDeployer() getters and its creation receipt while auditing this file, replacing stale values from the superseded deploy.

config._comment: Base Sepolia. sequencerFeed is the zero address: Base Sepolia has no L2 sequencer-uptime feed, so RevenueEscrow skips that check. maxStaleness 86400s (vs 3600s on mainnet) because the Sepolia ETH/USD feed heartbeats far less often. slippageBps 3000 (30%, vs 100 on mainnet) because the Sepolia WETH/USDC pool the escrow swaps through is thin -- a tight bound would make ordinary harvests revert on normal slippage. minActivityUsdc 10000 ($0.01) is scaled down for Sepolia's small demo loans. usdc/weth/ccaFactory/router/ethUsdFeed/sequencerFeed/reputationRegistry/minActivityUsdc were re-read live from this hub's own config() (identityRegistry is not part of config() and is carried over unchanged from the pre-fix deploy, since it is fixed Base Sepolia infra, not something the hub redeploy could change).
